This issue highlights: Doubao App launches its "Find a Store" feature; merchants can mark locations on maps in batches, and users can complete store finding, price comparison, group-buy ordering, and one-click navigation within AI chat, forming a closed loop. Doubao integrates map layers into AI chat, consolidating the process from information acquisition to in-store consumption in a single interface and shortening the consumption path.
